4336-5006-8170-8249.easyPrerequisites: You haven't cast a spell using Lurrus this turn if Kobolds of Kher Keep is starting in your graveyard.
4336-5006-8170-8249.description:
Cast Kobolds of Kher Keep by paying {0}.
Flickering Hound triggers, blinking Lurrus.
Resolve the Kobolds of Kher Keep spell. Then, activate Defiant Salvager by sacrificing Kobolds of Kher Keep, putting a +1/+1 counter on Defiant Salvager
Repeat.

4452-6797-6871-6879.notablePrerequisites: You have an artifact creature in hand with the mana to cast it.
4452-6797-6871-6879.description:
Cast any artifact creature by paying its mana cost.
When the artifact creature enters as an Ally due to Rukarumel, Haru triggers, earthbending the artifact creature, as it's a land due to Toph.
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing the artifact creature.
When the creature dies, Haru triggers, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When the creature enters as an Ally due to Rukarumel, Haru triggers, earthbending the creature, as it's a land due to Toph.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on Phantom Train and causing it to become a creature until end of turn.
Repeat from step 3.

34-141-2034.easyPrerequisites: There's a creature card in your graveyard.
34-141-2034.description:
Cast Footsteps of the Goryo by paying its mana cost.
Holding priority, cast Naru Meha by paying its mana cost.
When Naru Meha enters, it triggers, targeting Footsteps of the Goryo.
Holding priority, activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Naru Meha, adding {C}{C}.
Resolve the Naru Meha trigger, copying Footsteps of the Goryo
Resolve the Footsteps of the Goryo copy, returning Naru Meha from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.

4050-6982--5.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the creature with persist.
When that creature dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When that creature enters, Stalwart Successor triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Remove a +1/+1 and a -1/-1 counter from that creature as a state-based action.
Repeat.

1325-5170-6132-8095.description:
Activate Hammerhead by sacrificing Metamorphosis Fanatic.
When Metamorphosis Fanatic dies, Kheru Bloodsucker triggers, causing each opponent to lose 2 life and you to gain 2 life.
Resolve the Hammerhead ability.
Activate Hammerhead by sacrificing Junji.
When Junji dies, it and Kheru Bloodsucker trigger.
Resolve the Kheru Bloodsucker trigger, causing each opponent to lose 2 life and you to gain 2 life.
Resolve the Junji trigger, returning Metamorphosis Fanatic from your graveyard to the battlefield and causing you to lose 2 life.
When Metamorphosis Fanatic enters, it triggers, returning Junji from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Hammerhead ability.
Repeat.

4681-5170-6797-7918.description:
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing Karmic Guide.
When Karmic Guide dies, Sifa Grent triggers, causing an opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain 1 life.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability.
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing Junji.
When Junji dies, it and Sifa Grent trigger.
Resolve the Sifa Grent trigger, causing an opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain 1 life.
Resolve the Junji trigger, returning Karmic Guide from your graveyard to the battlefield and causing you to lose 2 life.
When Karmic Guide enters, it triggers, returning Junji from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability.
Repeat.

3188-4399-4770-6626.description:
Cast Whitemane Lion by paying {0} and 2 life due to Defiler of Faith and The Wind Crystal.
Defiler of Faith triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When the Soldier enters, Social Climber triggers, causing you to gain life.
Resolve Whitemane Lion. When it enters, it and Social Climber trigger.
Resolve the Whitemane Lion trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Social Climber trigger, causing you to gain life.
Repeat.
3188-4399-4770-6626.notes: If your life total is below 3 to start, instead pay {W} when casting Whitemane Lion for the first time.

uses.n: The Legend of Kuruk // Avatar Kuruk

uses.battlefieldCardState: as a copy of Avatar Kuruk

6913-7009-7638.manaNeeded: {20} minus {1} for each creature and artifact you control each turn
6913-7009-7638.description:
Activate Chameleon using Avatar Kuruk's ability by paying {20} minus {1} for each creature and/or artifact you can tap while activating it, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
At the beginning of your end step, The Mind Stone triggers, blinking Chameleon. Choose to have it enter the battlefield as a copy of Avatar Kuruk.
Repeat each turn.

703-3771-7012.description:
Cast Astral Dragon by paying at most {6}{U}{U} due to Animar.
Animar triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
When Astral Dragon enters, it triggers, creating two copies of Airbender Ascension that are 3/3 Dragon creatures in addition to their other types.
When the Airbender Ascension tokens enter, they trigger, airbending Astral Dragon and up to one other creature.
Cast Astral Dragon from exile by paying at most {1} due to Animar.
Repeat from step 2.
703-3771-7012.notes: The other Airbender Ascension trigger can be used to blink creatures you control. You would cast that creature in between step 3 and step 4, blinking it each iteration. The starting mana cost is reduced by {2} if Animar has a +1/+1 counter on it, then is reduced by an additional {1} for each +1/+1 counter on it beyond the first.

465-3742-4251-4452-4742.description:
Declare Phantom Steed and Godo as attackers, triggering each of their second abilities.
Resolve the Godo trigger, untapping all creatures you control and causing you to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Resolve the Phantom Steed trigger, creating a token copy of Wormfang Drake.
When the token Wormfang Drake enters the battlefield, its first ability triggers, exiling Godo.
At the end of your combat phase, Phantom Steed triggers, causing you to sacrifice the Wormfang Drake token.
When the token Wormfang Drake leaves the battlefield, its second ability triggers, returning Godo from exile to the battlefield.
When Godo enters the battlefield, its first ability triggers, allowing you to search your library for an Equipment card and put it onto the battlefield.
Repeat each combat phase.

1765-2292-6888.description:
Cast Traveling Plague by paying {3}{B}{B}, attaching it to another creature you control.
When Traveling Plague enters, Chishiro triggers, creating a creature token.
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing the creature Traveling Plague is attached to.
When the creature dies, Traveling Plague triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to the token created in step 2.
When Traveling Plague enters, Chishiro triggers, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability.
Repeat from step 3.

250-779-1479-5412-6528.easyPrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn.
250-779-1479-5412-6528.description:
Play Dakmor Salvage.
When Dakmor Salvage enters, Elfsworn Giant and Kodama trigger.
Resolve the Kodama trigger, choosing to put nothing onto the battlefield.
Holding priority, activate Coastal Hornclaw by sacrificing Dakmor Salvage.
The Gitrog Monster's second ability triggers, causing you to mill two cards and return Dakmor Salvage from your graveyard to your hand.
If a land was milled this way, The Gitrog Monster's second ability triggers, causing you to draw a card.
Resolve the Coastal Hornclaw ability
Resolve the Elfsworn Giant trigger, creating a token.
When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama triggers, putting Dakmor Salvage from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Dakmor Salvage enters the battlefield, Elfsworn Giant triggers.
Repeat from step 4.

198-1680-3767-3918.description:
Activate Trazyn using Empowered Autogenerator's ability by tapping it, putting a charge counter on it and adding one mana of any color for each charge counter on it.
Activate Trazyn by paying {2}, untapping it.
Repeat.
198-1680-3767-3918.notes: The mana cost assumes Trazyn has no charge counters on it. If it does, the cost will be {0}.

586-4924-5147-5258-5618.description:
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Priest of Gix.
When Priest of Gix dies, Rakdos triggers.
Holding priority, activate Haunted Crossroads by paying {B}, putting Priest of Gix from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Rakdos trigger, causing you to exile the top three cards of your library with the ability to play them until your next end step.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability from step 1.
Cast Priest of Gix from exile by paying at most {2}.
When Priest of Gix enters the battlefield, it triggers, adding {B}{B}{B}.
Repeat.

1497-2646-3327-4613.notablePrerequisites: You have sacrificed at least three artifacts and/or creatures this turn, plus an additional artifact or creature for each time you've cast Dargo from the command zone this game.
1497-2646-3327-4613.description:
Cast Dargo from the command zone by paying {R}, causing it to enter the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it due to Bloodspore Thrinax.
Activate Dargo using Wild Cantor's ability by sacrificing it, adding {R}.
Choose to return Dargo from your graveyard to the command zone.
Repeat.

277-1479-5700-5701-6528.notablePrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn.
277-1479-5700-5701-6528.description:
Play Petrified Field.
When Petrified Field enters the battlefield, Kodama of the East Tree and Elfsworn Giant trigger.
Resolve the Kodama of the East Tree trigger, putting nothing onto the battlefield.
Holding priority, activate Petrified Field's second ability by tapping and sacrificing it, returning Echoing Deeps from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Elfsworn Giant trigger, creating a token.
When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama of the East Tree triggers, putting Echoing Deeps from your hand onto the battlefield as a copy of Petrified Field.
When Echoing Deeps enters the battlefield, Elfsworn Giant and Tiller Engine trigger.
Resolve the Tiller Engine trigger, untapping Echoing Deeps.
Holding priority, activate Echoing Deeps using Petrified Field's second ability by tapping and sacrificing it, returning Petrified Field from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Elfsworn Giant trigger, creating a token.
When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama of the East Tree triggers, putting Petrified Field from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Petrified Field enters the battlefield, Elfsworn Giant triggers.
Repeat from step 4.

1987-2493-4276-4863.notablePrerequisites: Lands you control can tap to produce at least {4}{U}{U}{U}.
1987-2493-4276-4863.description:
Activate any number of lands you control by tapping them, adding at least {4}{U}{U}{U}.
Cast Turnabout by paying {2}{U}{U}, untapping all lands you control.
Cast Ghostly Flicker by paying {2}{U}, blinking Archaeomancer and Revolutionist.
When Archaeomancer and Revolutionist enter the battlefield, they trigger, returning Turnabout and Ghostly Flicker from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.
1987-2493-4276-4863.notes: If lands you control can tap to produce at least {5}{U}{U}{U}, this combo nets infinite mana. You can then stop casting Turnabout and blink one other permanent using Ghostly Flicker. You may also tap artifacts and/or creatures instead for mana if desired.

372-1809-3563.notablePrerequisites: You have any number of other nonland permanents that enter the battlefield untapped, and that can collectively tap to produce enough mana to cast Flicker of Fate exiled by Abdel Adrian.
372-1809-3563.description:
Cast Flicker of Fate by paying its mana cost, blinking Abdel Adrian.
Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield, returning Returned Pastcaller and all other cards that were exiled with it to the battlefield.
Abdel Adrian and Returned Pastcaller trigger.
Resolve the Returned Pastcaller trigger, returning Flicker of Fate from your graveyard to your hand.
Holding priority, activate any number of nonland permanents you control by tapping them, adding at least enough mana to cast Flicker of Fate.
Resolve the Abdel Adrian trigger, exiling Returned Pastcaller and the mana-producing permanents until Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield, and creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token for each permanent exiled this way.
Repeat.

3783-4300-4955.notablePrerequisites:
You control an Illusion that has Grafted Wargear attached to it.
You control a land that enters the battlefield untapped and that can tap to produce at least {1}.
3783-4300-4955.description:
Activate a land by tapping it, adding at least {1}.
Activate Meloku by paying {1} and returning the land from the battlefield to your hand, creating a 1/1 Illusion creature token.
Activate Grafted Wargear's equip ability by paying {0}, attaching it to a different Illusion.
Grafted Wargear triggers, causing you to sacrifice the Illusion it was initially attached to.
When the Illusion dies, Minn's second ability triggers, putting a land from your hand onto the battlefield.
Repeat.

146-169-538.description:
Cast Pact of the Titan choosing to pay its replicate cost an arbitrarily large number of times, paying a total of {0}.
Pact of the Titan's replicate ability triggers, causing you to copy Pact of the Titan for each time the replicate cost was paid.
Resolve the first Pact of the Titan, creating a 4/4 Giant creature token.
When the Giant enters the battlefield, Impact Tremors triggers, dealing 1 damage to each opponent.
Repeat from step 3 for each remaining Pact of the Titan.

224-1525-1644-3177.notablePrerequisites: You have a land card in hand.
224-1525-1644-3177.description:
Activate Sakura-Tribe Scout by tapping it, putting a land card from your hand onto the battlefield.
When the land enters the battlefield, Tatyova and Retreat to Coralhelm trigger.
Resolve the Retreat to Coralhelm trigger, untapping Sakura-Tribe Scout.
Resolve the Tatyova trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and reveal cards from the top of your library until you reveal a land card and put it into your hand.
Repeat.

2060-2178-2577-4170.notablePrerequisites:
Thornbite Staff attached to Fain.
Fain does not have summoning sickness.
You control at least one additional Zombie.
2060-2178-2577-4170.description:
Activate Fain's first ability by tapping it and sacrificing Gravecrawler.
 Gravecrawler dies, triggering Fain, untapping it.
Resolve the Fain ability from step 1, putting two +1/+1 counters on Crystalline Crawler.
Activate Crystalline Crawler's first ability by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, adding {B}.
Cast Gravecrawler from your graveyard by paying {B}.
Repeat.
Once you have infinite mana and counters, you may instead activate Fain's other abilities.

220-2191-5109.description:
Cast Martyrdom by paying {1}{W}{W}, targeting Brash Taunter.
Cast Volcano Hellion by paying {2}{R}{R}.
Volcano Hellion enters the battlefield, triggering its ability, targeting any creature.
Holding priority, activate Brash Taunter's ability from Martyrdom any number of times by paying {0}, causing any amount of damage that would be dealt to you to be dealt to Brash Taunter instead this turn.
Resolve the Volcano Hellion trigger from step 3, dealing an arbitrarily large amount of damage to the targeted creature and to Brash Taunter.
Brash Taunter triggers, targeting an opponent.
Holding priority, activate Brash Taunter's ability from Martyrdom many times by paying {0}, causing the next large amount of damage that would be dealt to the targeted opponent to be dealt to Brash Taunter instead this turn.
Resolve Brash Taunter's ability, redirecting some of the damage back to Brash Taunter but still dealing lethal damage to the opponent.
Repeat from step 6 once for each remaining opponent.

719-1558-3263-4338.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least five other creatures.
"Cleric" chosen with Xenograft.
719-1558-3263-4338.description:
Activate Time Sieve by tapping it and sacrificing five creatures.
The creatures die, triggering Rotlung Reanimator five times, creating five 2/2 Zombie creature tokens.
Resolve the Time Sieve ability, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.

618-813-2103.description:
Cast Capture of Jingzhou by paying {3}{U}{U}, causing you to take an extra turn.
Activate Kiki-Jiki by tapping it, creating a token copy of Scholar of the Ages with haste.
The token copy of Scholar of the Ages enters the battlefield, returning Capture of Jingzhou and any second instant or sorcery card from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat each turn.

822-1358-5261.easyPrerequisites:
Roar of the Kha is exiled by Isochron Scepter.
Isochron Scepter doesn't have summoning sickness.
822-1358-5261.notablePrerequisites: Creatures you control can tap to produce at least {2}.
822-1358-5261.description:
Animate Isochron Scepter using Sydri.
Activate any number of creatures by tapping them, adding at least {2}.
Activate Isochron Scepter by paying {2} and tapping it, casting a copy of Roar of the Kha without paying its mana cost.
Resolve Roar of the Kha, untapping all creatures you control
Repeat from step 2.
